name: tau-verified-session-integrity-checkpoints
instr:
Tau cannot prove exact history prefixes with portable, branch-scoped integrity checkpoints without changing provider-visible conversation context. Implement checkpoint creation, verification, resume, inspection, and export without changing uncheckpointed sessions.

Compute deterministic SHA-256 checkpoints from canonical persisted root-to-parent ancestry, independent of object identity and JSON key order. Ignore changes outside that ancestry. Commit pending entries and checkpoints atomically. Interruption exposes the previous transcript; retry adds exactly one valid checkpoint for an unchanged tip.

Before publishing history, resume applies `SessionIntegrityPolicy` values `IGNORE='ignore'`, `WARN='warn'`, and `REQUIRE='require'`. Strict failures raise `SessionIntegrityError` with `report`; new and legacy uncheckpointed sessions remain allowed. `IntegrityStatus` has `VALID='valid'`, `INVALID='invalid'`, and `UNVERIFIED='unverified'`. Diagnostics distinguish digest, ancestry, algorithm, and malformed-record failures without exposing arbitrary content.

Idle CodingSession operations and correlated `checkpoint` and `verify_integrity` RPC requests share stable report fields and status meanings. Active-turn checkpoint requests append nothing. Malformed commands and unsupported policies return one correlated failure without stopping later processing. `SessionManager(paths=None)` provides async `verify_session(self, session_id)`. `render_session_integrity_report` from `tau_coding.int
